- Load test plan: ramp to 2k concurrent sessions over 48h, then sustained 20k MAU simulation via synthetic user traffic. Expected token throughput ~120M tokens/day at peak. I’ll run the first pass Wed 5/5 and share the report by Fri 5/7.
- Constraints: the current trial cluster is single-region (us-west). For multi-region failover we can stand up a second cluster but that takes ~5 business days to provision.
- SSO: Okta is straightforward; we have a short checklist I’ll share for the IdP setup.

I’ve pushed the working SOW to the shared Drive and attached a draft here (SOW_draft_helix_2027_v1.docx). Procurement: please review sections 2.1 (trial scope) and 6.2 (data retention) closely — we can tighten retention windows if needed.
